description: Caller builds romantic relationship over time then requests money for emergencies, travel, or business problems
indicators: professing love or strong feelings quickly
requesting money for emergency or travel
claiming to be overseas or unable to meet in person
avoiding video calls or in-person meetings
claiming to be military, engineer, or doctor abroad
mentioning business deals or investments gone wrong
asking for help with customs or travel documents
promising to repay money soon or meet in person
example_scripts: I love you so much. I need money for a plane ticket to come see you.
I'm stuck overseas and need money for medical treatment. Please help me.
My business deal fell through. Can you lend me money until I get back on my feet?
I want to be with you forever. Just help me with this one emergency and we can finally meet.
I'm in the military stationed abroad. I need money to process my leave papers so I can come home to you.
My daughter is sick and I need money for her surgery. You're the only one I can turn to.
I have a large inheritance coming but need money to pay the lawyer fees. I'll pay you back double.
I'm an engineer on an oil rig. I need money to finish my contract so I can come be with you.
Customs is holding my luggage with valuable items. Send money to release it and I'll repay you when we meet.
I love you more than anything. This is just a temporary setback. Once you help me, we'll be together forever.
urgency_phrases: no one else to turn to
red_flags: Professing love very quickly (within days or weeks)
Always has excuses for not meeting in person
Refuses video calls or sends limited photos
Stories become increasingly dramatic and urgent
Requests money repeatedly with different excuses
Claims to be in another country or remote location
Promises to repay but never does
Uses overly romantic or scripted language
seasonal_patterns: increased around Valentine's Day and holidays
psychological_tactics: exploiting loneliness and desire for companionship
making victim feel special and loved
isolating victim from friends and family
relationship_progression: initial contact on dating site or social media
promises to meet that never materialize
